set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem four_consecutive_residue_law (n : ℕ) : ∃ k : ℕ, n + (n + 1) + (n + 2) + (n + 3) = 4 * k + 2 ∧ (n + (n + 1) + (n + 2) + (n + 3)) % 4 = 2 := by
  refine ⟨n + 1, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega
